summary: BUG: No Clear Visual Differentiation Between “Approved” and “In Progress” Work Order Statuses
reported_issue: On the Work Orders list view, 'Approved' and 'In Progress' appeared visually similar (both green badges), making it difficult to quickly distinguish the two operational states.
expected_after_fix: Approved and In Progress should have distinct visual styling (color/badge), so users can identify the operational stage at a glance.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin and opened /workorders (list + 'By Status' grouped view).
Captured computed styles of status badges: Approved renders teal (color rgb(0,105,92) on rgb(224,242,241)).
No in_progress WOs exist in current staging data, so extracted the status→color map from the live JS bundle to compare Approved vs In Progress directly.
actual_now: Live status→color map: approved:["teal-10","teal-1"] (teal) vs in_progress:["green-10","green-1"] (green). Approved and In Progress now use different color families and are clearly distinguishable. Same underlying issue as SV-6784.
notes: Duplicate of SV-6784 (same root cause). Confirmed distinct colors via both rendered UI and the JS bundle color map.
